summary: The change adds the missing `quality` and `test-shards` CI jobs to the self-observation allowlist and maps the five test-shard matrix display names to the logical `test-shards` job. The regression test covers every added name, and unknown names retain the `unknown-job` fallback.

evidence: ops/self-defects.ts lines 56-91 now accepts `quality` and `test-shards`, including all five test-shards matrix display names.
tests/repair/self_defects_test.ts lines 62-81 asserts every added CI job name produces an allowlisted key rather than `unknown-job`.
.github/workflows/ci.yml lines 20 and 41-47 define `quality` and `test-shards` with exactly the modules, integration, host-1, host-2, and host-3 display names covered by the change.
